evidence.quote: Fees No tuition fees, only student union fee
You are considered to be an international applicant if You are not a German citizen or a citizen of a member state of the European Union (EU) or the European Economic Area (EEA).
apply directly to DIT via our own online application portal, Primuss

notes: The application period 15 October – 1 December is the deadline for all countries for this programme (summer semester start); the year is not given, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. TUITION: the programme's own page (https://www.th-deg.de/eai-b-en) says 'No tuition fees, only student union fee' for this programme; the DAAD page states a 500 EUR semester fee for non-EU applicants, which conflicts with the programme page for this non-EU applicant — both quotes are candidates, the programme page says no tuition. The general unibersity-wide €500/semester service fee (non-EU/EEA) and the €60 application fee are recorded as a manual check, not as tuition. Application channel: international applicants apply directly via DIT's own Primuss portal; no uni-assist involvement is mentioned. The documents list comes from the general international application section of https://www.th-deg.de/en/apply.

note.fr: Un test d'admission en ligne (mathématiques) est requis pour toutes les candidatures reçues entre le 1er octobre et le 1er décembre. La date est fixée par le jury.
note.en: A successfully completed online admission test (mathematics) is required. For applications received between 1 October and 1 December, the test takes place shortly after the application period and its date is set by the examination board.

evidence.quote: A successfully completed admission test (online option available). The test consists of questions from Mathematics.

note.fr: Les frais de dossier (60 EUR) et les frais de service semestriels (500 EUR) s'appliquent aux candidats et étudiants internationaux non-UE/EEE.
note.en: A €60 application fee and a €500 DIT service fee per semester apply to non-EU/EEA international applicants and enrolled students.

evidence.quote: €60 application fee (multiple applications possible without further payment) at the Deggendorf Institute of Technology, plus €500 DIT service fee per semester for enrolled students
